changelog:
Take your own notes during a meeting.

When you record a call, a notes box opens in the corner. Type a note and press Enter - it's stamped with the time in the call. Your notes show up in their own section of the meeting, you can search for them later, and they feed the summary, so a to-do you typed becomes an action item even if nobody said it out loud.

Reloading the dashboard mid-call no longer loses the recording timer.

Also new since 0.1.66: note categories, and notes now sync both ways between your phone and desktop.
